## About
Nortown Collision & Glass Co is an auto body collision repair and glass shop at 20035 Van Dyke Ave in Detroit, serving customers throughout the Detroit Metro area and all of Southeastern Michigan.
You'll deal with people who know your name. Our contact page lists Gene, Al, Al Jr. and Kathy, and one reviewer who worked here as a teenager wrote that "Al and his dad are great people." We handle collision, painting, glass and mechanical repair.
Our customers rate us 4.5 from 73 Google reviews. Insurance claims are welcomed, and we can help with a rental car while yours is in the shop.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Auto body collision repair, with vehicles repaired back to factory specifications.
- Auto Body Painting: Paint work using the highest quality paints and materials.
- Glass Repair and Replacement Services: Glass repair and replacement, right alongside the body work.
- Auto Hail Repair: Paintless dent repair for hail damage, so you keep your original factory finish.
- Mechanical repair: We're a collision and mechanical repair facility. One reviewer came in with a bad blower motor and was back on the road the same visit.
- Rental cars: Courtesy and rental cars so you can get to work while repairs are made.
- Pickup and Delivery Service: We can pick your vehicle up and bring it back.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Just stop by during business hours and we'll look at your vehicle.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. Insurance claims are welcomed, and one reviewer said we work really well with their insurance company.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We do repairs for all makes and models, foreign and domestic.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We back our work with customer satisfaction.
